ModMetaData.name: GateRim SG-1
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
GateRim SG-1 brings the Stargate SG-1 universe to RimWorld.
Current development scope: - Inheritable Jaffa lineage genes - Prim'ta Hediff prototype for an implanted immature symbiote - Medical Jaffa Prim'ta implantation prototype - Physical Prim'ta larva resource consumed by implantation surgery - Constructible Prim'ta incubation basin and larva-production bill - Raw-meat nutrient requirement for Prim'ta larva incubation - Vanilla preservation prototype for physical Prim'ta larvae - Dedicated non-food biological storage category for Prim'ta larvae - Prim'ta larva temperature-tuning prototype with heat acceleration - Prim'ta implantation biological-age eligibility prototype - Progressive Jaffa puberty dependency prototype without Prim'ta - Lightweight Jaffa Prim'ta cultural-thought prototype - Temporary tretonin substitution prototype for Jaffa without Prim'ta - Drug-lab tretonin acquisition prototype using one Prim'ta larva - Formal Jaffa Prim'ta ceremony prototype at the Goa'uld ritual basin - Tok'ra foundation prototype with voluntary adult-symbiote implantation - Developer-spawnable player-controlled Tok'ra voluntary-host pawn prototype - Tok'ra pawn-group foundation prototype for developer tests - Low-frequency natural Tok'ra peaceful visitor incident prototype - RimWorld-oriented Tok'ra biological healing with curable-condition filtering and progressive wound regeneration - Explicit voluntary Tok'ra therapeutic implantation prototype with consent confirmation - Time-limited escorted Tok'ra therapeutic-opportunity incident with explicit refusal and coordinated departure - Persistent Tok'ra trust tiers modulating therapeutic-offer duration, escort size and tretonin support gifts - Trust-gated independent Tok'ra medical-support delivery incident - Trust-weighted storyteller chances for Tok'ra therapeutic offers and medical-support deliveries - Persistent wary Tok'ra diplomatic cooldown after refused or expired therapeutic offers - Trusted Tok'ra medical-support deliveries include one advanced ultratech medicine unit - Goa'uld host xenotype prototype - Free Goa'uld symbiote pawn prototype - Recent Goa'uld implantation Hediff prototype - French translations for stabilized content - Player wiki maintained in parallel - Centralized colored C# logging scaffold - Windows build wrapper - Persistent Goa'uld symbiote identity data - Interactive forced Goa'uld implantation prototype - Automatic conversion into an active Goa'uld host state - Manual emergency extraction during recent implantation - Medical emergency Goa'uld extraction surgery - Autonomous free-symbiote pursuit and contact implantation - Controlled ritual Goa'uld implantation prototype - Explicit map target selection for ritual implantation - Timed core ritual ceremony with cancellation and save persistence - Core Goa'uld ritual basin environmental requirement - Developer-spawnable Goa'uld queen biological-foundation prototype - Developer-only queen-origin immature-symbiote extraction prototype - Queen-origin assisted Prim'ta maturation at the incubation basin - Powered Prim'ta preservation-basin storage prototype - Persistent Prim'ta deep-freezing penalties outside active preservation basins - Hidden hostile Goa'uld System Lord faction-foundation prototype - Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa pawn kinds and hidden Combat-group prototype - Automatic Prim'ta provisioning for generated Goa'uld-aligned Jaffa servants - Craftable Ma'Tok staff weapon prototype with dedicated temporary graphics - Natural Goa'uld raids, settlements and world presence planned later - Global object-category audit planned before final stabilization - Optional Ideology integration, expanded ceremony requirements and host transfer planned later
Biotech is required for xenotype support.
This is an early development version.
